ads.title: Don\u2019t Choose Your Birth Course on Price Alone!
ads.body:
There are cheaper birth courses out there. But when it comes to preparing for your baby’s birth, it’s worth considering what’s included.

The Positive Birth Program™ combines comprehensive childbirth education with practical hypnobirthing techniques, resources for birth partners and tools you can use throughout labour and birth.

Invest in comprehensive birth preparation.

Join Australia’s #1 Childbirth Education Program

ads.title: Birth Classes That Fit Your Life
Build Your Business With A Trusted Name
ads.body:
Hypnobirthing Australia™ Practitioner Training gives you more than the training needed to teach the Positive Birth Program™.

You’ll receive professional teaching resources, practical guidance on setting up and running your classes, access to practitioner support and a profile in the Hypnobirthing Australia™ national practitioner directory. 

So when you complete your training, you’re not simply walking away with a certificate — you have the resources, guidance and support to take the next step towards building your childbirth education practice.

Learn More

ads.title: Our Program. Every Birth.
ads.body:
Birth is a very unique experience, so our course is not rigid; we provide you with the tools to navigate your birth, no matter what path your birthing takes.

We aim for a natural birth; however, you’re well prepared, no matter what path your birthing takes.

Whether you choose pain relief, need medical support, or have a spontaneous, intervention-free birth…

Our goal is the same → to help you feel prepared, calm, supported, and positive about your experience — whatever that means to you.⁠

Get started today.

ads.title: Childbirth Training That Fits Your Life
ads.body:
You don’t need to put your existing commitments on hold to become a childbirth educator.

Hypnobirthing Australia™ Practitioner Training gives you two flexible ways to complete your 21 hours of live training: 3 full days or over 6 weeks.

Both formats are live, interactive and delivered online, so you can choose the option that best fits your schedule — without giving up the benefits of learning with an experienced trainer.

View Training Dates

ads.title: Start Your Birth Course Now. Learn at Your Own Pace.
ads.body:
Think you’ve left it too late to complete your birth course? You haven’t.

With bite-sized online lessons, you can start now and work through the Positive Birth Program™ at a pace that works for you.

Give yourself the time and space to prepare for birth.

Flexible birth preparation, whenever you need it.

Join Today

ads.title: Turn Your Experience Into Something More
ads.body:
Your existing experience matters.

Whether you’re a midwife, doula, naturopath, hypnotherapist or another birth professional, Hypnobirthing Australia™ Practitioner Training gives you the specialised knowledge, framework and practical teaching skills to build on what you already know.

Learn to teach the Positive Birth Program™ and confidently support families with evidence-based, practical childbirth education.

ads.title: Learn From Years of Birth Education Experience
ads.body:
When you’re preparing for one of the biggest experiences of your life, experience matters.

The Positive Birth Program™ has been developed by Hypnobirthing Australia™ and Melissa Spilsted, with 16+ years of experience supporting Australian parents through birth preparation.

It’s practical, evidence-based, and has been tried and trusted by major Australian hospitals.

Australian knowledge. Practical skills.

Gain Access Now

ads.title: Take Your Birth Skills Further
ads.body:
Ready to expand your skills in childbirth education? 

You can complete your 21 hours of live practitioner training online, without needing to travel to attend in person.

Choose between 3 full days or 6 weeks of interactive training with Australia's premier hypnobirthing expert, Melissa Spilsted.

A practical way to develop a new specialisation while managing your other commitments.

View Training Dates

ads.title: Choose Birth Education Backed by Real Results
ads.body:
When choosing a childbirth education course, it’s worth looking beyond the price tag.

The Positive Birth Program™ has been implemented in Australian hospital settings, with reported improvements in birth outcomes:

↓ 52% Reduction in Caesareans 
↓ 15% Reduction in Inductions
↓ 32% Reduction in Epidural Use

Get the practical tools and knowledge to prepare for your birth.

Evidence-informed education. Practical birth preparation.

Join Australia’s #1 Childbirth Education Program
